title: Core compatibility of tensor restriction with canonical open-section comparison
statement: After expanding the transport along hi and the canonical tensor-to-restriction comparison, the tensor restriction map commutes with these component comparisons and the ordinary presheaf restriction.

proof.text: Use the unit equation for the left-adjoint uniqueness comparison and the normalized composition comparison, then evaluate at top sections.

mathlib_searches.query: tensor restriction canonical open section comparison naturality

lean.statement: theorem etaleTensorOpenSectionIso_component_core (X : Scheme.{u}) (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale) (hi : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor) (F : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opensᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) : (i.op ⋙ etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf F).map f ≫ (eqToIso (congrArg (fun T : Over X ↦ Γ((tensorPullback T.hom).obj F, ⊤)) (congrArg (fun k : X.Opens ⥤ Over X ↦ k.obj V.unop) hi))).hom ≫ (tensorOpenSectionIso X F V.unop).hom = (eqToIso (congrArg (fun T : Over X ↦ Γ((tensorPullback T.hom).obj F, ⊤)) (congrArg (fun k : X.Opens ⥤ Over X ↦ k.obj U.unop) hi))).hom ≫ (tensorOpenSectionIso X F U.unop).hom ≫ (F.presheafModuleCat ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f
